question: Assess RNA-protein agreement for cardiomyocytes, hepatocytes and neutrophils in the Human Protein Atlas using single-cell-type RNA nCPM and Deep Visual Proteomics cell-type Intensity. Join by Ensembl ID and those exact cell-type names. For each cell type separately retain genes with positive measurements in both modalities, report the retained count, Spearman correlation and overlap/Jaccard of the top twenty genes ranked independently by RNA and by protein. Give the top-twenty lists with values. Convert within-cell-type ranks to percentiles (ascending average rank divided by retained count), and select five genes per cell type with the largest absolute RNA-minus-protein percentile difference, ties by Ensembl ID. Give their measurements, percentiles and main subcellular locations. Draw three RNA/protein scatter panels restricted to the union of each cell type's two top-twenty lists, a top-twenty-overlap bar chart and a discordance heatmap. Supply the top-list union measurements and the aggregate and discordant-gene tables. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Cell type\" FROM rna_single_cell_type WHERE \"Cell type\" IN ('Cardiomyocytes','Hepatocytes','Neutrophils','cardiomyocytes','hepatocytes','neutrophils') ORDER BY 1"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Cell type\" FROM dvp_cell_type WHERE \"Cell type\" IN ('Cardiomyocytes','Hepatocytes','Neutrophils','cardiomyocytes','hepatocytes','neutrophils') ORDER BY 1"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT COUNT(*) master, COUNT(DISTINCT \"Ensembl\") distinct_master FROM proteinatlas"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH b AS (SELECT r.\"Cell type\" AS cell_type, r.\"Gene\" AS ensembl_id, r.\"Gene name\" AS gene_name, TRY_CAST(r.\"nCPM\" AS DOUBLE) AS rna, TRY_CAST(d.\"Intensity\" AS DOUBLE) AS protein, p.\"Subcellular main location\" AS main_location FROM rna_single_cell_type r JOIN dvp_cell_type d ON r.\"Gene\"=d.\"Gene\" AND r.\"Cell type\"=d.\"Cell type\" JOIN proteinatlas p ON r.\"Gene\"=p.\"Ensembl\" WHERE r.\"Cell type\" IN ('cardiomyocytes','hepatocytes','neutrophils') AND TRY_CAST(r.\"nCPM\" AS DOUBLE)>0 AND TRY_CAST(d.\"Intensity\" AS DOUBLE)>0), q AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cell_type ORDER BY rna) AS rr0, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cell_type,rna) AS rrc, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cell_type ORDER BY protein) AS pr0, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cell_type,protein) AS prc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cell_type ORDER BY rna DESC, ensembl_id) AS rna_top, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cell_type ORDER BY protein DESC, ensembl_id) AS protein_top FROM b), x AS (SELECT *, rr0+(rrc-1)/2.0 AS r_rank, pr0+(prc-1)/2.0 AS p_rank FROM q), a AS (SELECT cell_type, COUNT(*) AS retained_n, corr(r_rank,p_rank) AS spearman, SUM(CASE WHEN rna_top<=20 AND protein_top<=20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_overlap FROM x GROUP BY cell_type) SELECT cell_type, retained_n, spearman, top_overlap, 40-top_overlap AS top_union_n, top_overlap/CAST(40-top_overlap AS DOUBLE) AS jaccard FROM a ORDER BY cell_type"}
